scope: Source-only static review of three isolated DD matmul regressions; no test import or execution

checks.actual_operands: frame4 unscaled complete DD 2x2 operands at solid e1275/q6 and solid e1348/q8; not already-upscaled frame3
checks.reference: For each of all four matrix entries, exact two-term dot of Decimal.from_float(hi)+Decimal.from_float(lo); both operand words retained
checks.precision: 2000 digits is sufficient for stored finite binary64 operands; independent Inexact flag cleared at context entry and required unset
checks.error_gate: abs(represented_exact_DD_sum - exact_dot) <= 2^-98 * sum(abs(exact_dot_product_terms)); 2^-98=64*(2^-52)^2; no absolute floor
checks.cancellation: Sum of absolute individual physical product terms gives an appropriate DD accumulation scale even when their final sum cancels
checks.support: All returned DD components must remain finite and satisfy original pair_supported; no range-gate replacement
checks.unselected: False branch compares dtype/shape/C bytes of both result words directly with unchanged ci.dd_matmul
checks.path: ROOT=parents[3] is correct only after copying the author file to the declared repository stage; external author location is not an execution target
checks.AST_compile: Source parsing and compile only; no exec/import

limits: These three tests do not constitute full captured force/tangent qualification
No new JAX/AD, equilibrium or contact qualification
